entries.text: The proxies page keeps its search when you come back to it
The proxies page warns when a group's filter leaves no node, or GLOBAL is set to DIRECT in global mode
Switching mode closes the connections the old mode routed, like switching proxies
Fix the Linux AppImage opening to a black window on newer distributions
Requests and live connections on one page, a smoother traffic card and new log lists, from upstream FlClash v0.9.3
Auto-select groups leave an unusable first node at once, from upstream FlClash v0.9.3-pre.2
Windows updates install silently and reopen the app
A rebuilt interface and reworked Core protocol, from upstream FlClash v0.9.3-pre.1
Hysteria2 and other QUIC nodes connect right after the VPN starts
Hysteria2 nodes no longer fail right after the app starts or the network changes
The TUN MTU defaults to 1500 so large downloads no longer stall; an MTU left at the old 9000 moves to it
Fix a build error in the Android plugin
Optional general overrides that apply sooner, from upstream FlClash v0.9.2
A beta program page to join or leave the beta and see the current channel
A beta channel in the updater that returns to the stable release once it ships
DNS cache clearing, profile QR codes, phone-to-TV links, an access control bar and mihomo v1.19.33
Proxy group tabs as chips, a reworked scan page, no more password keyboard on plain text fields, popup and drag-back fixes, and the corrected strict route description in every language
Custom overwrites are removed; rebuild them as custom profiles
Redesigned dashboard, theme colors and proxy cards, French, Spanish and Korean, rewritten terms of use to sign once more, and no more Firebase analytics or crash reporting
Custom profiles, per-key DNS, NTP, sniffer and TUN settings, stacked sheets and context menus, and Android launcher shortcuts
The macOS menu bar, Dock and the Linux link handler show Panorama Secure Access
Updates now download in the background with a progress card and install in one tap
New keyhole logo across the app, tray and launcher icons
Redesigned navigation with a sidebar and floating dock, new dashboard cards, a DNS query log and system tray hotkeys
Patch known vulnerabilities in the Go networking and cryptography dependencies (golang.org/x/crypto 0.57.0, golang.org/x/net 0.60.0)
